values.note: Sirvoy booking engine for summer 2027 (Tue June 15 and Sat June 19 alike), prices shown 'incl. taxes & fees': 30-amp full-hookup sites $63.60/night, 50-amp $79.50; tent site $37.10. A non-refundable $50 booking fee per camping reservation. Pets $10 per pet, once per stay, at RV sites.

fees.source: https://secured.sirvoy.com/engine/book?id=b85a855e808fe0c8 ('Site #10 (30 Amp) Full Hookup ... $63.60 /night incl. taxes & fees', 'Site #25 (50 amp) ... $79.50', 'NON-Refundable Booking Fee: $50 Camping sites and $200 for cabins', '$10.00 Pet Fee (Per Pet) one time per stay'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The booking engine lists 31 full-hookup RV sites (#2-12, #17-20, #25-40) with posted pad sizes: lengths 27 to 49 ft, widths 16 to 32 ft (site 6 marked 'Narrow'), plus a tent site and cabins.

facilities.source: https://secured.sirvoy.com/engine/book?id=b85a855e808fe0c8 ('Site #7 ... Close to bathrooms and showers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book on the Sirvoy widget on the park's own site or at 406-450-0035. Cancelling within 7 days of check-in forfeits the whole stay; the $50 booking fee is non-refundable. The earliest date the widget offered was 2027-05-15.

booking.source: https://heartofglacierrvpark.weebly.com/ ('Start Booking Below!') + Sirvoy engine text ('If cancelling within (7 Days in the campground) ... you will be charged for the entirety of your stay'; default check-in 05/15/2027), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://secured.sirvoy.com/engine/book?id=b85a855e808fe0c8 ('We offer a Veteran and Active Military Discount. Please indicate your status in your reservation.'), read 2026-10-21

note: RV park and cabins on the north edge of St. Mary (6 West Shore Rd), at the east entrance of Going-to-the-Sun Road. Several pads are narrow (16-18 ft wide). --Claude
summary: Read the operator's Weebly site and its Sirvoy booking engine: added fees $63.60 (30-amp) to $79.50 (50-amp) a night incl. taxes for summer 2027, a $50 non-refundable booking fee, 50-amp full hookups, showers, reservable online, a veteran/military discount, and posted pad sizes (27-49 ft). Not stated: season (the widget's earliest date is 2027-05-15), site count, other facilities.
flags: Price gate lifted: Glacier National Park gateway (0.6 km from the St. Mary entrance, gateways.py). Base $63.60/night incl. taxes (summer 2027) is over US$50. The family has not stayed here.
Presence: the Weebly site is two pages (home with the booking widget, contact page with phone 406-450-0035 matching the entry) but working.
